original_target.title: Global regularity of viscous planar MHD without magnetic diffusion

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.

sources.scope: Strip T x R, small perturbations of sheared field xi bounded uniformly away from zero; extra compatibility conditions.

registry_checks: No nonresistive/non-resistive alias Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI full metadata. Current arXiv, primary author/publisher, Zenodo, HAL, GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Original every decaying smooth Hk velocity/magnetic field on R2, full velocity viscosity, no magnetic diffusion/damping, no background. Small perturbation of nondecaying sheared field on a strip does not cover it. Compressible MHD, resistive-only and damping systems differ.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. Actual 2026 stability theorem remains restricted.
